reasonLegend.A10: Client-side view/helper code; frontend owner retains unless overridden below.
reasonLegend.A11: Static asset requires frontend ownership and URL preservation unless overridden below.
reasonLegend.A12: HTTP/business logic mixed in service module; split controllers from server services.
reasonLegend.A13: SQL schema/migration authority; retain order, constraints, roles and existing data.
reasonLegend.A14: Server configuration uses current-directory .env/fixture assumptions; make application-root explicit.
reasonLegend.A15: Loopback/request principal security seam; preserve local guard and replace fixed identity before remote access.
reasonLegend.A16: Canonical queued job dispatch/result authority with retries and stale-result fencing.
reasonLegend.A17: Private original/object storage and orphan handling with byte/hash integrity.
reasonLegend.A18: Record-backed scene output, HTTP asset response and URL generation; split transport, preserve display-only classification.
reasonLegend.A19: Governed provider policy/egress seam; no live provider call is authorized by extraction.
reasonLegend.A20: Curated NYC test source and saved fixture paths are hardcoded; source policy needs review before port.
reasonLegend.A21: Reachable synthetic crossing generator; historical data stays, operational route needs explicit retirement.
reasonLegend.A22: Synthetic-only dataset schema/intake/identifier route; retain stored originals and history, replace active ingestion.
reasonLegend.A23: Mixed canonical import/domain logic with demo-specific branches; split and retire demo paths selectively.
reasonLegend.A24: USP snapshots, commands, geometry, evidence, identity and packet services; preserve security/provenance invariants.
reasonLegend.A25: Shared document policy mixes server limits/profile mapping with browser accept copy; split ownership.
reasonLegend.A26: Pure domain identifiers or continuation state used by server services.
reasonLegend.A27: Saved presentation URL mapping crosses server and frontend; preserve redirects/query encoding.
reasonLegend.A28: Wire DTOs/status and display text share files; move canonical types to contracts, leave copy in frontend.
reasonLegend.A29: Transform math is imported by spatial ML server; formatting/color helpers are frontend-only.
reasonLegend.A30: Bounded CityJSON roof decoder/resource type is imported by server retained-source delivery.
reasonLegend.A31: Application ID assignment is server canonical logic, distinct from official parcel ULPIN issuance.
reasonLegend.A32: Pure source-record identity projection feeds both server assignment and frontend lookup.
reasonLegend.A33: Authored calibration route/fixtures are publicly exposed and test-consumed; decide compatibility explicitly.
reasonLegend.A34: Server compiler includes invented facade, roof and marking details; keep only qualified/display policy.
reasonLegend.A35: ZIP/hash reader and raster/point preview are mixed with synthetic presentation normalization; split.
reasonLegend.A36: Adapter schemas explicitly require synthetic classification and fictional assertions.
reasonLegend.A37: Render/presentation projections are consumed by synthetic saved-dataset server path and browser; split/retire.
reasonLegend.A38: Historical source mapping and limitations must remain available during migration.
reasonLegend.A39: Client-only topology preview uses vendored polygon-clipping; license must travel with it.
reasonLegend.A40: Legacy saved-link hash aliases are active compatibility data, not disposable sample files.
reasonLegend.A41: Authored Lake View district, invented units/occupants and scene generation are prototype-only.
reasonLegend.A42: Client export preview must stay distinct from access-checked server export/packet.
reasonLegend.A43: Pinned illustrative ML/evidence JSON is used by explainer/tests; retain provenance, do not call it official truth.
reasonLegend.A44: Next SSR pages directly query DB/server; move read projection to API and route selection to frontend.
reasonLegend.A45: Next proxy enforces host restriction across paths; replacement serving boundary needs equivalent control.
reasonLegend.A46: Next build config includes Cesium WASM minifier workaround/server externals; requalify new build.
reasonLegend.A47: Next-generated declaration ceases to be needed after Next removal.
reasonLegend.A48: One manifest/config currently mixes browser, Node, Next and tests; split dependencies/aliases/build steps.
reasonLegend.A49: Current web instructions include Next-generated rules; review guidance when app boundary changes.
reasonLegend.A50: Focused source/scene/URL test; migrate with owning module, do not count as runtime qualification.
reasonLegend.A51: Community OSM public copy has byte-identical fixture counterpart and source notes; preserve provenance.
reasonLegend.A52: Static explainer original/mask/receipt/evaluation assets form a linked evidence bundle.
reasonLegend.A53: Locally served fonts and corresponding OFL texts; preserve URLs/licenses.
reasonLegend.A54: Poly Haven style assets are referenced by frontend and hash-pinned in SOURCES.json.
reasonLegend.A55: Protected comparison reference manifest pins other evidence images and review notes.
reasonLegend.A56: Browser-side file-kind routing reads limited ZIP metadata; backend independently validates original bytes.
reasonLegend.A57: Browser mask decoding supports ML review view; not canonical segmentation authority.
reasonLegend.A58: Pure source-attribution projection is consumed by server investigation PDF and frontend map; share it.
